The user asks in Spanish: "A 3D route in the Alhambra de Granada in a single HTML file. Save what you generate in the current folder."

I need to create a single HTML file with a 3D route through the Alhambra. Use Three.js via CDN. Let me build something nice: a 3D scene with the Alhambra monuments (Alcazaba, Nasrid Palaces, Generalife, Carlos V Palace), a camera following a route, waypoints with labels, maybe an animation along path, orbit controls.

Let me check current directory first.

I'll write a self-contained HTML using Three.js from CDN (module import from unpkg/jsdelivr). Include:
- Terrain/plateau
- Simplified buildings: Alcazaba towers, Palacio de Carlos V (circular courtyard building), Nasrid palaces (rectangular blocks with courtyards), Generalife with gardens, Torre de la Vela, walls, cypress trees.
- Route curve with CatmullRomCurve3, animated camera or a moving marker, waypoint markers with HTML labels.
- UI: play/pause, speed, list of stops, info panel in Spanish.
- OrbitControls.
- Optional first-person flythrough along path; default orbit view.
